objectives: Cut single-stock lines from 24 to 8: keep only large, liquid, high-conviction names of at least ~2% each.
Exit every position below ~2% that is not a deliberate satellite, and fold its exposure into a fund or ETF.
Bring the AI-exposed share of the equity sleeve down from about a third to about a fifth, in line with the house view that AI is being repriced (Nasdaq -4.9% and semis -12.3% on 5 Nov).
Add the regions and sectors the portfolio lacks: healthcare and biotech, Europe, Switzerland, India and the broader US market (equal weight).
Consolidate overlapping exposures: six China lines into one ETF, two Japan vehicles into one fund, three space names into one.
Keep a cash buffer of about 6.5%, consistent with the house overweight on cash, to redeploy into the same targets in stages.
